asset.description: the plant/equipment the verification relates to, **when it resolves**

competency.description: the competency entity the verification created, whose name is the form title

external_id.description: the source form-result's own identifier, as text

financial_period.description: the accounting period the verification falls in, derived from `occurred_at`

form_id.description: the source form template identity the verification was captured on

occurred_at.description: when the verification was submitted; the date the 365-day compliance clock runs from

source_system.description: which bound system emitted the row; `ASSIGNAR` today

submission.description: the tenant's own verification form — its question labels and answers, including the licence/certificate evidence the form captures

title_label.description: the tenant's own name for the competency, taken from the form title

worker.description: the worker the verification is about
